purpose: Preserve Quranic source spans, normalize analysis forms separately, segment bounded clitic candidates, and expose typed causal markers without changing source text.
inputs: UTF-16 .NET strings containing Quranic or natural Arabic text
invariants: Source text and source spans are preserved separately from normalized analysis.
Causal edges are emitted only after their typed lexical and mood contracts pass.
Unsupported forms remain explicit diagnostics rather than inferred success.

determinism.replayContract: Identical input text and source snapshot produce identical ordered outputs and diagnostics.

performanceContract.guarantee: No asymptotic or latency guarantee is claimed in v2.

limitations: This module is not a statistical language model.
Its causal inventory is bounded and does not establish general causal reasoning.
verification: Generated mutation and deterministic replay tests
